answer: Opening a challenge costs a deposit of 43 units that is returned only on a graded submission, so abandoning an attempt is a real loss. Because the oasis deposit is held in the timber escrow, the pearl audit records each forfeiture and the cost of a failed attempt is fixed rather than optional. A farm that opens challenges speculatively across many aliases hence burns capital on every one it does not finish. The fee repeats 30 times over. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
